method: 2386 paired fixed steps at 120 Hz, alternating execution order of complete-measurement and early-rejection variants. Same actual anatomy and Berenstein catheter advance/hold/withdraw commands; rendering omitted.
proof: After contact geometry and any lumen cone repair, boundary residual > tolerance excludes settled acceptance, and boundary/tolerance > previousMerit*(1-1e-4*scale) excludes merit acceptance. Full merit is a maximum containing this same boundary term.
scope: Built-in joint-active-coulomb position-history line search, passes after the unconditional first pass and trial indices 0..6. Last trial stays complete for final failure diagnostics. Split motion, witness discovery, nonfinite thresholds and custom kernels without opt-in remain complete.
telemetry: earlyRejections counts partial rejection certificates separately. measureCalls includes partial and full evaluations; fullMeasureCalls counts completed evaluations. Dominant-error categories describe only fully evaluated rejected trials.
caveats: No rendering or live-browser FPS measurement.
Sequential runs showed -16.3% measure cost but +2.6% total time, with changed timings in untouched stages; paired alternating runs reduce that order/background-load bias.
The number of trials and the existing 800 unconverged steps are unchanged; this optimization only shortens evaluations of known failures.

paired.method: Interleaved fixed steps, alternating variant order, shared read-only anatomy, no rendering
